title: Count Subarrays With Loose Bounds
statement: The task is to count subarrays of an integer array, with n up to 10^5 and values up to 10^6, in which every element lies between minK and maxK inclusive. Out-of-range elements split the array into maximal valid runs, so a linear scan adds the current run length (the number of valid subarrays ending there) at each index, giving L(L+1)/2 per run.
